notes: Makes Jarvis more responsive, capable, and observable. Govee lights now understand canonical color names such as brown and safely accept custom #RRGGBB shades, validating and converting every color to Govee's packed RGB integer. Complex questions dynamically select the highest-ranked compatible reasoning model advertised by the relay while commands stay economical and spend limits, tool support, and bounded fallbacks remain enforced. Every accepted utterance gets a heard-you cue and a quiet cancellable working pulse on the active device. Explicit 'Talk on this device' now atomically takes ownership even when a stale resume token exists, while automatic reconnect still resumes safely. Interruption reacts faster without forwarding echo candidates. Logs and the voice controller show a bounded metadata-only event timeline with stage durations; no audio, transcripts, keys, or unbounded frame data are recorded.
